name: What should I prepare before discussing a major home renovation or addition project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before discussing a major home renovation or addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an initial consultation for a major renovation or addition, considering your primary goals, desired functionality, and aesthetic preferences can be beneficial. Gathering any inspirational images, rough ideas of layout changes, or a general understanding of your budget range will help us better understand your vision. AKN Design Group will guide you through the detailed planning process, but having a preliminary concept helps frame our discussions and ensures we focus on solutions that align with your unique lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before discussing a major renovation, consider your goals, desired functionality, aesthetic preferences, and a general budget range.
